summary_for_children: Al-Mutaffifin means Those Who Give Less. It warns traders who cheat on weight and measure.
environment_concept: A morning market stall: a pair of honest scales with brass weights (83:3), and sacks of grain beside an empty wooden measure that can be filled right to the brim (83:2). No person is shown, and the Day, the registers and the next life of 83:4-36 are not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A canopied market stall, balance scales with weights, grain sacks and a wooden measure.

areas.name: Honest Scales
areas.description: A pair of scales with brass weights, level and true.

areas.name: Full Measure
areas.description: Sacks of grain beside a wooden measure to fill to the brim.

activities.name: Read the first three
activities.description: Put the first three ayahs of Al-Mutaffifin in order.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match the scales and the measure to the ayah each comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Fill the measure
activities.description: Tap the grain sack three times to fill the measure right to the brim.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own scene (a market stall with honest scales and a measure to fill), two playable games and one activity played in the scene

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
